movement_source: row 'Net profit after tax from continuing operations – cash basis', column Year ended 30 June 2025 -> column Year ended 30 June 2026
headline: CBA's cash NPAT increased $730 million or 7% to $10,982 million in FY26 (FY25: $10,252 million). Statutory NPAT was $10,866 million (FY25: $10,116 million). Total operating income grew 6% to $30,224 million, while underlying operating expenses rose 6% to $13,585 million. Operating performance before impairment increased 7% to $16,469 million.

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: NII increased $1,563 million or 7% to $25,586 million (FY25: $24,023 million), driven by an $92 billion increase in average interest earning assets, partly offset by a 3 basis point decrease in net interest margin to 2.05%. (ev-65, ev-66)

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: Other operating income increased $196 million or 4% to $4,638 million (FY25: $4,442 million). Growth was supported by commissions (+$135m) and other income (+$46m), partially offset by lower trading income (-$9m). (ev-1, ev-2, ev-3, ev-4, ev-6)

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: Underlying operating expenses increased $719 million or 6% to $13,585 million (FY25: $12,866 million). The increase reflects inflation and investment in technology, frontline staff, and operations. (ev-16, ev-94)

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: Restructuring and notable items increased by $40 million to $170 million (FY25: $130 million), representing a negative contribution to earnings growth. (ev-17)

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: Loan impairment expense increased $62 million or 9% to $788 million (FY25: $726 million). The rise was driven by Retail Banking Services (+$106m) and New Zealand (+$11m), partially offset by Business Banking (-$45m). (ev-21, ev-22, ev-23, ev-24)

drivers.columns: Year ended 30 June 2025 -> Year ended 30 June 2026
drivers.narrative: Corporate tax expense increased $208 million or 5% to $4,699 million (FY25: $4,491 million), reflecting a 30.0% effective tax rate compared to 30.5% in the prior year. (ev-33)

notable_items: Restructuring and notable items were $170 million in FY26, up from $130 million in FY25.
limitations: Expenses are claimed on the underlying/notable split; the bank equally publishes the combined headline framing, so both claims are capped at 80.
